reasoning.description: Logic-driven reasoning for the version bump. Note: The IDE must handle/create tags to maintain the git log chain.

release_summary.description: The 'Hero' paragraph. A high-level, project-centric narrative (passive voice). Must explicitly state the tangible benefits, pros, and systemic impact of the release. Tone: Approachable, insightful, and genuine. No emojis.

title.description: Clinical title (e.g., '1. Type Safety Hardening'). No emojis. Passive voice.

sub_points.description: Optional nested bullets. Passive voice only.

problem_statement.description: Insightful description of the hurdle. Passive voice.

step.description: Command mood or passive voice. AI MUST format markdown as: '1. **Step:** [step string]'

outcome.description: Passive voice only. AI MUST format markdown as: '   * **Outcome:** [outcome string]'

component_name.description: Must strictly evaluate the file path against the CleanStack Architecture ADR before categorizing. Layer map: @substrate = index.html, manifest.json, assets, appsscript.json | @core = api/, theme/, services/, utils/, Scoring_Kernel | @shared = ui/, composables/, directives/, Store, View, Database | @features = roster/, laboratory/, headhunter/, scoring/, settings/ | @app = router/, layouts/, sw.ts, App.vue, Orchestrator, Registry | @root = vite.config, package.json, tsconfig, API_Public, Controllers.

filename.description: The file path. AI MUST format markdown list items as: '* **[Filename]**: '

change_summary.description: Passive voice only. Placed on the same line after the filename string.

omission_strategy.description: Formatting string (e.g., '* - [Count] additional files omitted for brevity.').

architectural_shifts.description: Optional. Detect and highlight when foundational project rules, ADR pillars, or structural dependencies change (e.g., deprecation of legacy docs in favor of a unified ADR, migration of build tools, or new governance policies). Each entry is rendered as a bullet under Key Improvements or as a dedicated subsection.

full_changelog_url.description: Absolute URL to GitHub comparison. Mandatory for git log integrity.

final_markdown_output.description:
Clinical OCD Formatting. Must use exact separators: ' ---
' before H2 headers. End with Full Changelog line then EXACTLY ' --- ---'. No emojis. Scannable bold highlights. Passive voice. AI MUST strictly follow the exact Markdown rendering formats embedded in the Deep Dive and File List component descriptions. If architectural_shifts exist, they MUST be surfaced prominently.
